text.EN: Nice hit... just don't let them get close.
text.TL: Magandang tama... huwag mo lang silang palapitin.

text.EN: You killed it... keep your eyes on the shadows.
text.TL: Napatay mo... bantayan mo ang mga anino.

text.EN: It's dead... just watch out for more.
text.TL: Patay na... mag-ingat lang sa iba pa.

text.EN: Okay, that one's gone... please stay watchful.
text.TL: Sige, wala na 'yon... pakiusap magmatyag ka.

text.EN: Good swing... don't turn your back on them.
text.TL: Magandang hataw... huwag mo silang tatalikuran.

text.EN: It's on the floor... keep watching every door.
text.TL: Nasa sahig na... bantayan ang bawat pinto.
Bagsak... tumingin ka lang sa lahat ng sulok.

text.EN: You dropped it... God, please be careful.
text.TL: Ibinagsak mo... Diyos ko, mag-ingat ka.

text.EN: Handled... just don't let your guard down.
text.TL: Naasikaso... huwag mo lang ibaba ang depensa.
